en.title: Rusted Fists and Birds of the Sky
en.premise: Once hailed as a genius, I abandoned my fists following a certain incident. Amidst the struggle of living at rock bottom, I am met with the earnest, clumsy challenge of a junior. This is a story of a man who puts his gloves back on, aiming for the sky from the depths of life, and punching his way through the wall known as despair.

zh.title: 锈蚀之拳与天空之鸟
zh.premise: 曾被称为天才的我，因某件事件而放弃了拳头。在挣扎求生的日子里，我接受了一位笨拙后辈那赤诚的挑战。重新戴上拳击手套的我，将从人生的谷底向着天空，击碎名为绝望的壁垒。
